speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing acute diarrhea; to help you properly, could you tell me how long this has been going on and how many times you have had a bowel movement in the last 24 hours?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (Clostridioides difficile infection). The patient is a 58-year-old female on levofloxacin who developed frequent watery diarrhea with cramping; I recommend obtaining a stool test for C. difficile toxins immediately.
